methodology: Waves and figures come from data/figures.json — 5 waves carry a 2026 year, plus the Store & Convention Exclusives bucket's 2026 entries. Release dates, windows, and announced MSRPs come from data/preorders.json (21 tracked items); announced prices are never market prices. Price movements use data/price-signals.json only — reported sold bands, averages, listings, and claimed prices with named sources. The Chronicle publishes no price index, and no 2026 figure has reported aftermarket data in the archive yet. The Top 10 is scored, not vibes: each entry's documented distinctions are counted (first-ever figure = 2 points; first-since-a-year, notable pack-in, format distinction, archive-first, or documented 2026 market story = 1 each). Ties break alphabetically. Every distinction cites its record. Best-value ranks announced per-figure MSRP only, using pack sizes stated in each item's own tracker record. No aftermarket data, no quality scores, no speculation. KO coverage is the documented record: no new 2026 counterfeit wave was documented; specific KO listings are named with their sources. Rarity highlights come from the Rarity Guide's tiers.

top10.display: Spider-Man: The Animated Series retro wave

distinctions.claim: Reissues the sold-out Pulse VHS exclusives on retro blister cards
Textbook sellout → aftermarket spike → reissue → premium collapse

top10.blurb: The reissue-cycle story of the year: the sold-out Pulse VHS exclusives return on retro blister cards at the standard $27.99 — with the first-ever solo-carded 6-inch Aunt May leading the wave.

distinctions.claim: First-ever Bastion figure per the tracker research (11.3-inch articulated wings); the archive's only other Bastion is the 2021 HasLab Sentinel X-Men Blue version
Made-to-order 2-pack at $74.99 — scarcity is the order window

top10.blurb: The biggest swing of 2026: an 11.3-inch-winged Bastion (documented as a first-ever figure in the tracker research) sold made-to-order — scarcity is the order window, not a chase ratio. Window closes November 20, 2026.
The first-ever Cypher figure arrived via Target's 2026 Geek-Out event — and made the encyclopedia's 2026 exclusives the same year.

top10.display: Marvel Legends × Magic: The Gathering Wave 2

distinctions.claim: Playable Magic: The Gathering card with every figure
Shipped October 2026 with an Amazon-exclusive Black Panther

top10.blurb: Shipped October 2026 with a playable Magic: The Gathering card in every box — plus an Amazon-exclusive Black Panther on top of the Doom / Captain America / Malice core.

distinctions.claim: Physical mini comic packed with every figure

top10.blurb: Every figure ships with a physical mini comic — and the wave delivers the first red Elektra since 2018 plus a Fraction/Aja-era Hawkeye straight out of Hawkeye #3 (2012).

distinctions.claim: 2021 Pulse Con exclusive reissued at Fan Channel — reissue-radar candidate resolving live
Retro cardback with no themed outer box

top10.blurb: The 2021 Pulse Con cel-shaded TAS Venom is back at Fan Channel retailers for $34.99 on a retro cardback — the reissue cycle resolving live, no themed outer box this time.

distinctions.claim: Full wave on retro blister cards
NYCC final-day panel confirmed the roster; pre-orders opened October 21, 2026

top10.blurb: The full wave on retro blister cards — Death Gambit with card-dealing effects, team-suit Cyclops, powered-up Jean — with its NYCC-confirmed roster and an October 21, 2026 pre-order date.

distinctions.claim: NYCC 2026 reissue with reported October 28 pre-order; price unannounced (single source)

top10.blurb: NYCC 2026's reissue play: the Astonishing X-Men two-pack returns with a reported October 28 pre-order — price not announced at reveal (single source).

distinctions.claim: Avengers: Doomsday film tie-in wave; Cyclops pre-orders opened July 27, 2026 at $27.99

top10.blurb: The MCU tie-in wave of the year — Thor with flight stand, Doctor Doom, Gambit, a James Marsden-likeness Cyclops (pre-orders opened July 27, 2026), Magneto, Shang-Chi, and Mr. Fantastic & H.E.R.B.I.E.

distinctions.claim: NYCC 2026 final-day panel reveal; pre-orders opened October 14, 2026

top10.blurb: Revealed on the NYCC 2026 final-day panel — Concept Series Lord Doom with open and closed spell books, a swappable-head Beast, and a fully-kitted Nightcrawler. Pre-orders opened October 14, 2026 for Spring 2027.

gaps: Price data covers 7 figures — none of them 2026 releases. The Fall 2026 waves' aftermarket behavior will be the first real test of the reissue-cooling pattern at scale.

The encyclopedia's 2026 archive is 5 dated waves (114 figures). The pre-order tracker covers 21 items, 17 with 2026 release windows or dates; undated 2027 reveals are listed in the timeline, not ranked.
No production numbers or chase ratios were ever officially documented for any figure on this page — the Rarity Guide's methodology applies here too.
